Time Series Analysis Question Answering Benchmark (TSAQA)
	

View our paper at: https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.23204  

	
		
		Introduction
	

TSAQA is a novel unified benchmark designed to broaden task coverage and evaluate diverse temporal analysis capabilities.
TSAQA integrates 6 diverse tasks under a single framework ranging from Conventional Analysis, including anomaly detection and classification, to Advanced Analysis, such as characterization, comparison, data transformation, and… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/TSAQA/TSAQA-Benchmark.
reputation: A newly released, comprehensive time-series QA benchmark on Hugging Face with growing interest but limited widespread adoption to date.
